claims.title: Continuation controls expose physical model-transfer and matched-baseline failures without closing the mission

status: Source-derived arguments and inspected producer replay; new extensions separately identified as integration-derived.
interface: Source-reported multi-lane continuation evidence preserved at exact archive revision and explicitly scoped internal audit. Selected physical/rare-path/model counterexamples and conditional constructions are reusable negative or conditional capital; inherited large data/source trees are indexed, not silently bundled or independently revalidated. Model/physical/prior gates remain open.
limits: Before reopening any lane, retrieve its exact inherited input, proof and primary-measurement scope; test the strongest same-interface comparator and acquire the missing physical/retained endpoint. Prioritize a decisive model/port/control falsifier or a measured action margin; preserve conditional counterexamples and never generalize a failed stipulated model into a universal scientific no-go. Sparse conjecture needs proof or counterexample.
